summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing for Laksono Kontraktor MVP. 31/31 backend pytest tests passed covering all public endpoints, auth (login/me/logout), admin CRUD (projects, blog, inquiries, settings), and admin overview analytics. Frontend: landing page, projects, blog, service detail all load with seeded data; admin login authenticates and redirects to dashboard; overview renders charts and totals; inquiries page lists submitted leads; protected /admin route redirects to /admin/login when unauthenticated; WhatsApp floating button present; Indonesian translation working.

issues: Single-month data (only May 2026) produces a single bar that fills the chart area completely, looks oversized. Cosmetic; will improve once more inquiries accumulate across months.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~890 lines containing models, endpoints, and large inline seed data. Recommend splitting seed data (SERVICES_SEED/PROJECTS_SEED/TESTIMONIALS_SEED/BLOG_SEED) into a separate seeds module and grouping routers per resource for maintainability (>700 LOC guideline).

CORS configured with allow_origins='*' AND allow_credentials=True. Browsers reject this combo for cross-origin requests with cookies; works here because frontend uses same-origin ingress. For production, set CORS_ORIGINS to explicit frontend URL.
Login cookie has secure=False — fine for current preview but should be True in production (HTTPS). Also consider adding rate limiting / brute force lockout (not implemented).
GET /api/auth/me on every public page load returns 401 (noisy console). Consider only calling /auth/me when a token exists in localStorage to suppress 401s for unauthenticated visitors.
seed_data_creation: No additional seed data needed; backend startup auto-seeds 8 services, 8 projects, 4 testimonials, 3 blog posts, settings, and admin user. Tests create and clean up TEST_ prefixed transient records.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py. Run: pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v. Uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Admin Bearer token flow is well-supported via Authorization header. Frontend uses data-testid: admin-email, admin-password, admin-submit, admin-error, admin-login-card. Login form pre-fills email so playwright should explicitly fill both fields with data-testid selectors.
